description:
Private, ad-free podcast app – audio only, no account, all data on your phone

AA-AuralListen Podcatcher is a private podcast app for Android. It plays audio podcasts only, needs no account, shows no ads and does no tracking. Everything you do in the app stays on your phone – there is no server of the developer.

Find and subscribe

  • Search Apple Podcasts and fyyd.de, subscribe by RSS address, import and export OPML
  • New podcasts start out provisional: listen in (streaming only), then subscribe
  • Rate podcasts with 1 to 5 stars – your subscriptions are sorted by it
  • Pull to refresh; moved podcasts (new feed address) are followed automatically
  • Red counter of unplayed episodes on each subscription; search within your subscriptions
  • Podcast page with description and links to the website and to support the podcast
  • Seasons: "S2·5" on the cover and a season filter; serial podcasts in listening order

Listening

  • Background playback with notification, lock screen and Bluetooth controls
  • Skip −15 s / +30 s, speed 1.0× to 2.0×, volume boost (global or per podcast)
  • Remaining time or total length at a tap; at higher speed also the real remaining time
  • Show notes with tappable links, episode number and release date
  • Chapters (Podlove, JSON, ID3) with the progress of the current chapter and per-chapter skip, bookmarks with notes
  • Sleep timer with gentle fade-out, also "until the end of the episode"
  • Remembers the position of every episode; an episode counts as played only at its end
  • Playback history of the last 100 episodes played to the end
  • Robust against network problems and MP3s with variable bitrate

Playlists

  • Several playlists that continue automatically, with colors, sorting and "Resume"
  • "Play next" and "Add to the end" for the playlist that is playing; ⏮ ⏭ in the player and via Bluetooth
  • Finished episodes leave the playlist at once, after 5 minutes or never – your choice
  • All new or unplayed episodes of a podcast, topic or season into a playlist
  • A symbol on every episode that is in a playlist

Downloads

  • Manual or automatic downloads per podcast, optionally into a playlist; "Wi-Fi only" with "Download now over mobile data"
  • Network feeds: downloads only for chosen topics; new episodes of a topic can arrive as played
  • Played downloads are deleted after 96 hours (not while they are in a playlist); adjustable storage limit

More

  • German and English, light and dark mode, selectable app color or the color of your wallpaper (Android 12+)
  • Episode numbers on the covers, backup and restore

The podcast search uses Apple's iTunes Search API and fyyd.de; your search term is sent to them. Everything else connects directly to the podcast providers.
